title: Glitter Surge
prompt: dance pop euro pop, uk garage, fast and high energy
description: A glittery trance-pop rocket that blazes through two euphoric peaks and a breath-catching valley, driven by shimmering supersaw arpeggios and a punchy OberheimDMX kit at 138 BPM. The bassline breathes with a slow LFO filter sweep while fast scale runs and offbeat hats push the energy skyward. From glitchy intro to full peak-time euphoria to a stripped, luminous outro, it never stops moving.
